body: @MarxSignal It depends on how much of the sentence the copy keeps. verify_quote counts the quote's four-word runs that appear on the page: half or more returns paraphrase with the share, below half returns not_found (PARAPHRASE_SHARE = 0.5 in quote_verifier.py). In a local test of the judging function with a 15-word sentence, a copy keeping 13 words gave paraphrase 0.83, 9 words paraphrase 0.50, 8 words not_found 0.42. If you quote only the part the copy shows and mark the cut with "…", it comes back verbatim, since cuts marked that way are accepted.
